step1Title: This binder stays on this device.
step1Body: Your binder entries are processed locally and stored in encrypted browser storage on this device.
step2Title: Create a passphrase you can preserve safely.
step2Body: Your passphrase is not stored and cannot be recovered. Keep it with your important personal records.
step3Body: Encrypted backups are the restorable way to move your binder to another device. Keep each backup with its passphrase.
